# rms_task_group (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS Task Group. Task groups organize related tasks for batch operations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_company" "main" {
  company_name = "My Company"
}

resource "rms_task_group" "maintenance" {
  name        = "Maintenance Tasks"
  description = "Group of maintenance-related tasks"
  company_id  = rms_company.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (Number) The company ID that owns this task group.
- `name` (String) The name of the task group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the task group.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in ISO8601 format.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the task group.
- `status` (String) The current status of the task group (e.g., 'active', 'paused', 'completed').
- `task_count` (Number) Number of tasks in this group.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp in ISO8601 format.
